segments.name: Private Client Group
segments.description: Provides financial planning, investment advisory, and securities transaction services to retail clients through employee and independent contractor financial advisors.
segments.evidence: We provide financial planning, investment advisory, and securities transaction services to clients through financial advisors.

segments.name: Capital Markets
segments.description: Conducts investment banking, institutional sales, securities trading, equity research, and affordable housing tax credit investments for corporate and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: Our Capital Markets segment conducts investment banking, institutional sales, securities trading, equity research, and the syndication and management of investments in low-income housing funds and funds of a similar nature, the majority of which qualify for tax credits (referred to as our "affordable housing investments" business).

segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Earns asset management and related administrative fees for providing asset management and portfolio management services to retail and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: Our Asset Management segment earns asset management and related administrative fees for providing asset management, portfolio management and related administrative services to retail and institutional clients.

segments.name: Bank
segments.description: Provides corporate and retail banking services to clients.
segments.evidence: The firm also provides corporate and retail banking services and trust services.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Includes other business activities not attributable to the four core segments.
segments.evidence: We currently operate through the following five segments: Private Client Group ("PCG"); Capital Markets; Asset Management; Bank; and Other.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay asset-based fees on accounts, transactional commissions and brokerage fees, investment banking fees, and net interest income, with revenues generally driven by assets under administration.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues from this segment are typically driven by AUA and are generally either asset-based or transactional in nature.
